NMTS Sunday Bosque Trail Ride

Albuquerque, NM · Road

NMTS Sunday Bosque Trail Ride is a road group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Open Space Shining River parking area.

How we know

NMTS's weekly rides page (copyright 2026, fetched Oct 1, 2026) lists the Sunday Bosque Trail ride at 9:00 am from the Open Space Shining River parking area, with a note that it moved there starting July 5 because of construction at Alameda Open Space.

About the NMTS Sunday Bosque Trail Ride group ride

A Sunday morning road ride along the Rio Grande bosque trail from Albuquerque's touring club. About 36 miles and open to all paces. Approved helmet required. The club posts a full weekly ride list on its site.
